paper_style.palette_strategy: 主文和附录结果图使用 Matplotlib 风格的蓝色 Baseline、橙色 PRISM；Figure 19 另用连续色阶编码 training step。表格为黑白 booktabs-like 规则，以粗体、分组和列方向表达比较；公式/算法使用 Computer Modern 数学字形。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: PDF 正文、caption、算法、表格和大多数曲线/散点为可提取的 PDF vector 对象；Figure 19 的连续色条在 p.34 含小型 raster image resource，其余对象没有独立高分辨率图像资源。整篇是以 vector 为主、局部 raster 的混合渲染。
paper_style.style_consistency: 主文图和附录图共享蓝/橙方法编码、浅色 dispersion 轨迹和 Matplotlib 轴式；主表与附录表共享 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern 和 booktabs-like 横线。差异集中在 caption 信息密度、图例位置、log 轴和附录诊断的未定义透明带。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1. Intrinsic DP-noise amplification during training (Math-10K). We plot the per-step ratio ∥N_Z∥_F^fac / ∥N_Z∥_F^PRISM, where ∥N_Z∥_F is the Frobenius norm of the effective DP noise on the merged LoRA update Z. The blue curve reports the raw per-step ratio, and the orange curve reports its moving average (MA) with window size w = 25 updates. Values > 1 indicate that applying DP-SGD in factor space (A, B) injects a larger intrinsic perturbation into Z than PRISM under the same privacy budget.

color.semantic_mapping: 蓝色为原始逐步 amplification，橙色为 w=25 moving average；黑色轴与白底提供结构。

figures.reusable_pattern: 用细粒度原始轨迹加窗口平均线承接机制诊断，但把重复/不确定性单独标出。

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2. Gauge sensitivity under DP (Math-10K). At step t we compute ρ_t = max_c ∥∆Z_t∥_F − min_c ∥∆Z_t∥_F across gauge-rescaled runs; smaller is better and ρ_t ≈ 0 indicates practical gauge invariance. PRISM drives ρ_t near zero, whereas factor-space DP exhibits persistently large ρ_t.

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1. Comparison with other DP-LoRA design choices. We evaluate each variant against three desiderata: (a) gauge-invariant randomized mechanism, (b) additive perturbations on Z (i.e., no bilinear DP term), and (c) LoRA-scale efficiency. The naive factor-space variant violates (a) and (b), yielding unbounded effective intrinsic noise E_Z. The one-sided variant, which updates B only while freezing A, satisfies (b) and (c) but not (a). PRISM satisfies all three and admits a closed-form expression for E_Z.

tables.uncertainty: No empirical uncertainty; E_Z is a closed-form symbolic quantity and “UNBOUNDED” is a qualitative failure value.
tables.data_and_statistics: Rows are DP-LoRA, One-side, PRISM; columns are Method, Params, E_Z, and desiderata (a)–(c). PRISM is bold and has checkmarks in all three columns.
tables.evidence_relation: Issue I–III desiderata → Table 1 sets the comparison contract → Section 3/Algorithm 1 constructs the row marked PRISM → Tables 2–5 test utility, scaling and cost.
design_strengths: Compactly binds invariance, additivity, efficiency and effective-noise claims.
Checkmarks and bold row make the design decision scannable.
design_weaknesses: Symbolic E_Z expressions are dense at small size.
The table states qualitative properties rather than empirical magnitudes or uncertainty.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a compact desiderata matrix before the method details, with a symbolic cost/noise column and explicit pass/fail marks.

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2. Utility on GLUE8 and Math-10K (higher is better). “Non-DP” uses the same setup without DP clipping/noise; ε ∈ {6, 3} uses DP-SGD with δ = 10⁻⁵. Avg is the unweighted mean over the 12 tasks; bold is best per column. Takeaway: Under DP, PRISM attains the best Avg and wins most tasks, especially on multi-step reasoning (GSM8K/MAWPS/SVAMP).

tables.uncertainty: No SD/SE or intervals; each cell is a single task score, and Avg is an unweighted mean over 12 tasks.
tables.data_and_statistics: Two header levels group GLUE8’s 8 tasks and Math-10K’s 4 tasks; Setting and Method are left columns and Avg is final column. Three row groups are Non-DP, ε=6, ε=3, each with six methods.
tables.evidence_relation: Method design contract/Table 1 → Table 2 headline utility on GLUE8 + Math-10K → Table 3–5 scaling/rank/overhead → Figures 1–4 mechanism diagnostics.
design_strengths: One wide decision surface compares privacy regime, method and 12 task outcomes.
Bold per-column winners and a final Avg make the main takeaway visible.
design_weaknesses: No replicate spread despite DP stochasticity; the caption only says Avg is unweighted.
Width and repeated method names create a high horizontal and vertical scanning cost.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use grouped task headers and a final aggregate column for multi-suite privacy utility, with row blocks for privacy regimes.

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3. Math-10K results on Gemma-3-4B-pt, Gemma-2-9B, and Gemma-3-12B-pt under DP (r = 16, ε = 6, δ = 10⁻⁵). The “Type” column indicates the backbone family; all experiments use text-only inputs. Bold indicates the best result within each backbone.

tables.uncertainty: No uncertainty; rows report single exact-answer accuracy values and Avg within each backbone.
tables.data_and_statistics: Columns are Backbone, Type, Method, GSM8K, AQuA, MAWPS, SVAMP, Avg; three backbone row groups contain AdamW, LoRA+, PRISM.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 2 main DP utility → Table 3 tests backbone family/size persistence → Table 4 rank sensitivity and Table 5 overhead.
design_strengths: Explicit Type column distinguishes text-only from multimodal backbone families while holding text-only inputs fixed.
Within-backbone bolding avoids comparing raw scores across backbone scales.
design_weaknesses: Mixed three- and four-decimal precision reduces column uniformity.
The caption says text-only inputs but Type includes multimodal, which requires careful reading.
tables.reusable_pattern: Repeat a compact method block per backbone and bold only within each block when scale changes alter the score regime.

tables.label: Table 4

caption.text: Table 4. Rank sensitivity on Gemma-3-4B-pt under DP (ε = 6, δ = 10⁻⁵; text-only inputs). Avg is the unweighted mean over all 12 tasks. PRISM is best across all tested ranks.

tables.uncertainty: No uncertainty; Avg columns are unweighted means over 12 tasks.
tables.data_and_statistics: Columns Rank, Method, GLUE8 Avg, Math Avg, Avg; three row groups r=8, r=16, r=32, each with AdamW, LoRA+, PRISM.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 2 baseline utility → Table 4 varies LoRA rank → Figure 1/4 and Appendix diagnostics address mechanism and noise rather than rank.
design_strengths: Directly tests rank robustness with identical backbone and privacy setting.
Three aggregate columns keep the rank comparison compact.
design_weaknesses: Aggregates hide task-level reversals.
Only three ranks are sampled, so the table cannot establish a continuous scaling law.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use repeated rank blocks with consistent aggregate metrics for a small, auditable sensitivity sweep.

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5. Runtime and memory profiling on Gemma-3-4B-pt for Math-10K (r = 16, ε = 6). Measurements use a single A100-40GB GPU with 10 warmup updates and 30 measured updates. PRISM roughly doubles step time in the current implementation, while peak memory is essentially unchanged.

tables.uncertainty: No uncertainty; 10 warmup and 30 measured updates on one A100-40GB GPU, with step time in seconds and peak memory in MB.
tables.data_and_statistics: Columns Method, Step time (s), Peak memory (MB); rows LoRA+, AdamW, PRISM.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 2 utility → Table 5 quantifies the runtime/memory trade-off → Limitations attributes practical cost to geometry-aware operations.
design_strengths: Places runtime and memory on one compact cost surface.
Caption fixes hardware and warmup/measurement protocol.
design_weaknesses: Single GPU and one workload limit portability.
Mixed units and no variability hide run-to-run systems noise.
tables.reusable_pattern: Pair performance claims with an explicit cost table using hardware and measurement protocol in the caption.

tables.label: Table 6

caption.text: Table 6. Dataset splits used in our experiments.

tables.uncertainty: No uncertainty; counts are split sizes, with “–” for not applicable train/eval cells.
tables.data_and_statistics: Columns Dataset/Split, Train, Eval; two bold group headers GLUE8 and Math-10K, with GLUE8 total and Math test rows.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 2 task suite → Table 6 makes train/eval denominators and split sizes explicit → Table 7/8 complete the reproduction configuration.
design_strengths: Separates training and evaluation counts in a compact schema.
Group headers and totals expose the composition of both benchmark suites.
design_weaknesses: MNLI matched/mismatched and mixture/test rows require special parsing.
No dataset version/date or filtering details appear in the table itself.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a two-column count table with group headers and explicit total/test rows for benchmark reconstruction.

tables.label: Table 7

caption.text: Table 7. Common hyperparameters shared across methods.

tables.uncertainty: No uncertainty; values are shared configuration settings, including ε∈{3,6}, δ=10⁻⁵, C=1.0 and seed 42.
tables.data_and_statistics: Columns Setting, GLUE8, Math-10K; rows cover backbone, LoRA rank/scaling/dropout, target modules, steps/batches, sequence length, input masking, seed, DP and backend/accountant.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 6 split sizes → Table 7 common controls → Table 8 method-specific optimizer/LR settings → reproducibility of Tables 2–5 and Figures 1–20.
design_strengths: Centralizes shared controls instead of repeating them in every result table.
GLUE8/Math-10K differences are visible in one side-by-side column pair.
design_weaknesses: Dense long strings such as target modules and accountant citations are small.
“SAME” cells require looking back to the GLUE8 column.
tables.reusable_pattern: Put invariant controls in a shared-configuration table and reserve the next table for method-specific deviations.

tables.label: Table 8

caption.text: Table 8. Method-specific hyperparameters.

tables.uncertainty: No uncertainty; learning rates are scientific-notation hyperparameters and the Supplementary column contains optional ratio/“–” entries.
tables.data_and_statistics: Columns Method, Optimizer, LR (GLUE8), LR (Math), Supplementary; six method rows from AdamW, FFA, RITE, LoRA+ and LAMB to PRISM.
tables.evidence_relation: Table 7 common settings → Table 8 records optimizer/LR deviations → Tables 2–5 and diagnostic figures can be interpreted without hidden per-method defaults.
design_strengths: Makes baseline-specific optimizer choices and LRs auditable.
The Supplementary column preserves the sole LoRA+ ratio override.
design_weaknesses: Citation-heavy optimizer cells wrap across lines.
No run-level convergence or tuning budget is included.
tables.reusable_pattern: Separate common hyperparameters from method-specific optimizer and learning-rate choices, retaining exceptions in a final column.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Introduction 用 Table 1 预置 gauge invariance、additivity 和 efficiency 三项 desiderata；Section 3 以 Algorithm 1 和公式把 PRISM 组织为 tangent projection → clipping/noise → adaptive transform → retraction；Tables 2–5 先给 privacy utility、backbone/rank scaling 和 runtime cost，Figures 1–4 再逐项诊断三类 failure；Appendix C 的 Figures 5–20 把 clipping、fixed-Z noise、raw noise、preconditioner scaling、conditioning 和 realized amplification 串成闭环。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 主文 Table 1–5 caption 同时交代设置、比较对象和部分主发现，Table 2 的 Takeaway 最完整；Figure 1–4 caption 定义主要指标、颜色/线型和主方向。附录 Figure 5–20 多为短标题，IQR、10–90% band、seed dispersion 或 proxy 的统计口径依赖邻近段落，caption 自包含性弱。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 结果表分别使用 desiderata matrix、GLUE8/Math-10K task groups、backbone/type/method、rank blocks 和 runtime/memory 列；附录表转为 split counts、common settings、method-specific settings。性能表多用 ↑/higher-is-better 语义和粗体，成本表用 seconds/MB 或 scientific notation。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Table 1 的设计契约 → Algorithm 1 与 Section 3.1–3.3 的 tangent mechanism → Table 2 utility headline → Table 3 backbone、Table 4 rank、Table 5 overhead → Figures 1–4 三个 issue diagnostics → Appendix C Figures 5–20 的 mechanism decomposition。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文 p.1–9 保留 Table 1–5、Algorithm 1 和 Figures 1–4；References p.10–12 后，Appendix Roadmap p.13 开始，Tables 6–8 提供 split/hyperparameter reproduction，Figures 5–20 承载 Issue I–III 的追加诊断。p.35 Figure 20 保留大量空白，说明附录图按证据链追加而非版式填满。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文和表格以 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern 为主；图内坐标、legend 和 colorbar 使用嵌入的 DejaVu Sans 家族。算法同时使用 Roman、数学和 monospace-like 字形。字号以 6–10 pt 图中文字为主，小图在双栏页中存在可读性压力。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 蓝/橙始终标识 Baseline/PRISM，透明浅色轨迹承载 dispersion；Figure 12 用额外绿色标识 PRISM 并用点线标记理论 gauge，Figure 19 用色条承载 training step。颜色与 legend 有冗余，但灰度下蓝/橙和浅色 band 的区分明显减弱。

most_reusable_patterns: 先用 desiderata matrix 固定机制比较维度，再用 Algorithm 1 把方法组件串成执行顺序。
将 headline utility、scale/rank、runtime cost 放在连续的主表决策面，并把解释性机制图放在同一结果页。
附录采用“时间带 → 固定状态 gauge sweep → σ sweep → proxy/realized amplification scatter”的诊断序列，把理论 failure mode 分解成可观察量。
highest_value_objects: Table 1：用三个 desiderata 把 gauge invariance、additive noise 和 LoRA-scale efficiency 绑定到同一方法接口。
Table 2：在 GLUE8/Math-10K、三 privacy settings 和 12 tasks 上提供主效用决策面。
Figure 12 + Figures 16–20：分别把 gauge-dependent noise 与 adaptive-preconditioning amplification 拆成机制级证据。
failure_patterns: 主效用与多数组件消融表只给点估计；DP seed variability 主要通过附录图的散点/带呈现，表格没有统一不确定性列。
附录短 caption 经常不定义透明带、proxy、seed 汇总或采样协议，读者必须往返正文段落。
结果图在蓝/橙之外混用绿色、连续色条、log 轴和不同 legend 位置；p.35 Figure 20 的大空白降低附录版式效率。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文先用 desiderata matrix 和 Algorithm 1 定义 intrinsic DP 机制，再用蓝/橙 utility 表与三类机制诊断，把 gauge dependence、bilinear noise 和 adaptive amplification 从理论公式连接到 fixed-Z sweep、σ sweep 与 low-rank stress evidence。
